slides.heading: Young Indians (Yi) Chennai Chapter Organizes Child Safety Summit
slides.text: A child safety summit organized by the Young Indians (Yi) Chennai Chapter in Maduravoyal, Chennai.

slides.heading: Event Details
slides.text: The event was held on Saturday, November 21, 2026, at Dayasadan Agarwal Vidyalaya, Maduravoyal.

slides.heading: Programme
slides.text: A train-the-trainer programme was conducted by Muktha Foundation, Bengaluru, involving teachers from more than 15 schools in Chennai.
